svg.title: The agent behind VYNN AI: how a question becomes an answer
svg.desc: A question in any language goes to a reasoning agent that reads it, picks the tools it needs and acts. A quick question is answered in seconds. When a question needs a full analysis, the agent gathers financials, builds a ten-tab model with live formulas, screens the news in parallel and writes a cited report, in about two minutes. Before anything is published, a deterministic calculator sets the rating and target, a validator checks every figure and requires at least 95% of material sentences to cite evidence, and a confidence check flags any large gap to analysts' targets, which are a benchmark kept apart from the valuation. A nightly canary gates every release.
